  have hr₂ : 0 < r₂ := by exact_mod_cast pos_of_mul_pos_left hL hL₂.le

    ((Θ_unique_le (q := fun _ : Unit ↦ q₂) (r := fun _ ↦ l * r₂)
      (hM1.trans hM) hq₂).trans ?_)
